messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Astra Labs (pilot cohort 7) just told us procurement is delaying the signed PO by ~2 weeks. They still want to start onboarding but asked to pause the full rollout. Flagging as potential renewal risk; thinking we keep momentum with a sandbox + condensed enablement + a lightweight POC. Notion with suggested schedule + prework: https://notion.redwood/invite/astralabs-pilot (see 'condensed path').
Luca: Thanks, Maya. Do we know what subset of the product they want to pilot? If it's embeddings-only we can cut enablement to 20–30m and focus on evals.
Priya: They originally signed up for convo + rerank flow. I can run a 45m workshop Tue 10–10:45 PT with hands-on prompts. @Maya can you confirm final attendee list (names + emails)? Also can CS export last 7 days of telemetry so they see signal?
Maya: Attendee list attached below. I'll export telemetry (usage, tokens, latency percentiles) and drop CSV into the shared drive. Also adding 'procurement_delay' tag in Gainsight.
Sam: If procurement timing is the blocker, offering a hosted POC with a temporary cost cap often helps legal move faster. Draft email to procurement + PM below — feel free to copy/edit:
```
Subject: Redwood pilot — temporary POC & cost cap
Hi Nora + team,
Understand the contract review timeline. To keep momentum we can provision a sandbox environment and run a 2-week POC on our hosted API with a $2,000 cost cap. No long-term commitment required; if you want we can bake in an NDA-friendly clause.
Link to sandbox + prework will follow.
Thanks, Sam (Solutions)
```
Maya: Nora from Astra replied in thread: "Procurement says contract review ~2 weeks. We still want onboarding materials and a sandbox to show our internal stakeholders progress."
Nora (Astra Labs): Quick note — sandbox access would be ideal so our data science lead can poke at embeddings before legal signs. Appreciate the cost cap idea.
Priya: Great — Nora, we can provision sandbox today and run the 45m workshop next Tue. @Luca can you enable a sandbox cluster (dev mode, limited tokens) for astra-labs by EOD? I'll create the calendar invite and prework doc (short prompt kit + eval checklist).
Luca: On it. I'll provision a dev sandbox with model 'redwood-small-v1' and a token cap of 50k. Command I used: ```rb prov sandbox --org astra-labs --env dev --model redwood-small-v1 --tokens 50000``` ETA ~3h. Will post the access link here when ready.
Maya: Thanks. I'll also upload the telemetry CSV and add a short one-pager for execs (showing week-over-week token usage + early sample outputs). @Sam can you finalize the POC email with the cost cap numbers and signoff verbiage for legal?
Sam: Ack — I'll update numbers, run a quick legal sanity check, and send the email today. Also adding a renewal-risk note in the internal handoff doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/handoffs/astralabs-pilot.
Priya: I'll capture workshop feedback with a 3-question micro-survey (post-workshop NPS-style) and tag any product asks in the feedback board.
OpsBot: Deployment note: sandbox astra-labs-dev created by luca at 1748342150.
Maya: TL;DR / next steps: 1) Sandbox provisioning in progress (Luca) 2) Workshop Tue 10–10:45 PT (Priya) 3) Sam to finalize POC email + cost cap 4) CS exports telemetry + prework (Maya) 5) Post-workshop micro-survey + feedback capture (Priya). I'll follow up in #customer-success tomorrow morning with status. :raised_hands:
